title: ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an Information Technology (IT) System franchise renewal application from Quest Diagnostics…
text:
[Council File 26-1494]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ARTS, PARKS, AND CITY FACILITIES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to an Information Technology (IT) System franchise renewal application from Quest Diagnostics Incorporated.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. APPROVE the renewal application of Quest Diagnostics Incorporated for the City's grant of an IT System franchise as detailed in the Information Technology Agency (ITA) report dated October 15, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present a draft Ordinance, with a ten-year term, allowing for the renewal of said franchise.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The ITA reports that approval of the IT System franchise renewal will generate $4,280 in annual franchise fees over the next ten years for a total of $42,800 during the ten-year term of the franchise. Additionally, an application fee of $2,500 is collected at the start of the renewal process.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 14, 2026 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 11, 2026
summary: Review of Quest Diagnostics Incorporated's application to renew its information technology system franchise with the city.
